prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image is STYLE AND PALETTE only. Create production game BACKGROUND art, original cute colorful 2000s handheld pixel-art world. Landscape canvas with FOUR equal 16:9 panels in exact 2 columns by 2 rows, no gutters or borders. Each panel is a true side-scrolling horizontal racecourse, like the TOP RIGHT reference panel. NO characters, animals, crowds shaped like racers, UI, text, signs, HUD or obstacles on the road. Top-left: sunny sunflower village countryside, lake behind a low wood fence, rounded trees and distant windmill. Top-right: warm gentle sunset meadow with pink clouds and tiny cottage. Bottom-left: festive championship arena with warm wooden grandstands, garlands, sunflower decorations, race gate behind the back fence, no running track white lanes. Bottom-right: blue-hour shrine garden with softly lit lanterns, cherry blossoms, distant shrine. For EVERY panel, scenic band occupies upper 52%; a CLEAR broad pale honey dirt course occupies y=52% to 92%, perfectly horizontal back/near edges, no diagonal path or vanishing point. Bottom 8% is flower verge and low foreground fence. No objects in the running corridor. Rich friendly pixel clusters, chunky 1-2 logical pixel outlines, no realistic textures or flat placeholder rectangles. At logical384x216 character sprite height30px, flowers behind fence approximately14px, fence20px, cottages60px. Terrain drawn fully at correct width, never stretched. Crisp coarse pixel art, matching supplied illustration. No gradients, no blurring, no labels. Original asset, do not copy copyrighted characters.

Use case: identity-preserve. Create a replacement production sprite atlas for these THREE original hamster protagonists. First input locks character identity, second input locks cute warm pixel-art style. Keep round small hamster bodies, modest cheeks, short limbs, tiny pink tail, tiny dark eyes with ONE small white highlight; not large bulging cheeks, no extra hair. EXACT grid SIX columns and SIX rows, evenly spaced identical square cells, no drawn grid, transparent background. Rows1-2: cream/orange Mochimaru, no accessories. Rows3-4: golden Dash, small red neckerchief and cream forehead star. Rows5-6: grey Hakase, thin round glasses. For each character first row poses LEFT TO RIGHT: idle standing 3/4 right, FOUR distinct quadrupedal running frames rightwards (rear push, gathered paws, stretched airborne, front landing), tucked-paw jump. In running frames FACE AND BODY MUST FACE RIGHT in natural side view, visible four tiny feet, no seated upright running. Same body dimensions, no size changes, feet on consistent cell baseline. Second row for each: nibbling EMPTY paws held at mouth, nibbling with rounder cheeks EMPTY paws, studying with small green pencil and white paper, studying concentrating with same pencil/paper, curled sleeping, happy smiling seated. No seed baked into sprites; food is a separate game layer. Warm original GBA-style pixel art, dark plum square-step outline, 16-color softly lit fur, deliberately chunky crisp pixel clusters at about56x56 logical resolution per cell. No blurry antialiasing, no glow, no colored fringe around transparency, no shadows outside bodies, no text. ALL ears, tails and paws fully inside each cell with at least15% transparent margin. Keep exact6x6 ordering. No other characters.
